description: Phase 6 Wave 2 — Plan 03: SPI route handler + ChatWindow endpoint routing. No web search. Base branch: ralph/phase-6-merged.

userStories.title: Implement SPI route handler at /api/chat/spi/[projectId]
userStories.description: As a student, I need to send messages in the SPI tab and receive streamed responses from the SPI persona interviewer using its full in-character interview system prompt.
acceptanceCriteria: Create directory `src/app/api/chat/spi/[projectId]/` and file `route.ts`
Route has `export const runtime = 'nodejs'` at top
Route has `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'`
Route imports and calls `getSPIContext()` from `@/lib/context`
Route reads `currentSession` from POST body with default 1
Route injects session: `const systemWithSession = \`${spiContext}\n\n[Current FUND II Session: ${currentSession} of 10]\``
Route uses `const AGENT_TYPE = 'spi'` as a constant
Route filters message history: `prisma.message.findMany({ where: { projectId, agentType: AGENT_TYPE }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } })`
Route uses `streamText` with `model: vertex('gemini-2.5-flash')` — NO `tools` key at all
Route persists user message with `agentType: AGENT_TYPE`
Route persists assistant message with `agentType: AGENT_TYPE` in onFinish
Route uses the same rolling window logic as Trend Mapper (first 4 + last 40 messages)
Route uses the same streaming response headers as Trend Mapper
File does NOT contain the string `tools:` (confirms no web search)
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes
userStories.notes: Read src/app/api/chat/[projectId]/route.ts fully first — copy its structure exactly but: (1) use getSPIContext() instead of getSystemContext(), (2) hardcode AGENT_TYPE = 'spi', (3) remove ALL tools. Identical structure to the VD route handler.

userStories.title: Add getEndpoint() routing helper to ChatWindow.tsx to route POST to correct agent endpoint
userStories.description: As a student, when I send a message in any agent tab, the correct agent's route handler must receive the request — not always the Trend Mapper handler.
acceptanceCriteria: Read src/components/ChatWindow.tsx to understand the current fetch call
Add a `getEndpoint(agentType: string, projectId: string): string` helper function at module level in ChatWindow.tsx (above the component)

getEndpoint returns: 'trend-mapper' → `/api/chat/${projectId}`, 'value-designer' → `/api/chat/value-designer/${projectId}`, 'spi' → `/api/chat/spi/${projectId}`, 'faro' → `/api/chat/faro/${projectId}`, default → `/api/chat/${projectId}`
Update the fetch call in ChatWindow's sendMessage/handleSubmit to use `getEndpoint(agentType, projectId)` instead of the hardcoded `/api/chat/${projectId}`
src/components/ChatWindow.tsx contains `function getEndpoint`
src/components/ChatWindow.tsx contains `value-designer`
src/components/ChatWindow.tsx contains `faro` (placeholder for Phase 7)
`npx tsc --noEmit` passes
userStories.notes: Read src/components/ChatWindow.tsx first to find the exact fetch call location. This is a minimal change — only add the helper function and update the one fetch URL. All other ChatWindow logic (streaming, state, error handling) stays unchanged. The FARO case must be included even though Phase 7 isn't done yet — it just needs the URL string.
